title: London temp anomaly z>1 vs TTF 5d (null control)
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] London temp_anomaly 20d z-score > 1 leads TTF=F log returns by 5 days (-) as a null control on the temp_min result; trade short TTF=F 5d on warm anomaly [weather.london.temp_anomaly -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0026)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.london.temp_anomaly rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 3 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Null control confirmed: London temp_anomaly is noise for TTF; test the reverse sign on the same anomaly for the TTF/Henry Hub ratio - London temp_anomaly 20d z-score > 1 leads finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub by 3 days (-); trade short TTF/HH ratio 3d [weather.london.temp_anomaly -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub] (parent: R2-0125)
